_comment: The `mcpServers` shape, which Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf and LM Studio all read. Copy the `mcpServers` block into your client's config file and replace the paths. For the config file path per client, and for the formats Codex CLI, Continue, Zed and Goose use instead, see docs/CLIENTS.md.
_comment_paths: Windows-style paths shown; escape backslashes in JSON (\\) or just use forward slashes, which work on every platform. Set ASEPRITE_MCP_WORKSPACE explicitly to the folder your art lives in: relative sprite filenames resolve inside it. Left unset, it falls back to a `workspace` folder beside the repository in a source checkout, and otherwise to a per-user data directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%/aseprite-mcp/workspace on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/aseprite-mcp/workspace on macOS, $XDG_DATA_HOME/aseprite-mcp/workspace on Linux). It is never placed inside the Python installation.
_comment_launch: `run aseprite-mcp` holds .venv/Scripts/aseprite-mcp.exe open, which blocks `uv sync` on Windows while the server runs. Swap the last argument for `python`, `-m`, `aseprite_mcp` to avoid that.
